purpose: Digitized public inputs and bounded reproduction expectations for Biology Line E.

raw_inputs.title: GDS112 yeast heat shock time course
raw_inputs.sha256_note: Raw GEO input is downloaded from public GEO FTP at reproduction time and digested into outputs/input_digests.json.

raw_inputs.title: GDS20 yeast hyper-osmotic shock time course
raw_inputs.sha256_note: Raw GEO input is downloaded from public GEO FTP at reproduction time and digested into outputs/input_digests.json.

reference_inputs.title: Direct SGD/GO response to osmotic stress genes
reference_inputs.extraction_rule: Direct GO:0006970 annotations only; NOT qualifiers excluded.

expected.interpretation: Expected honest negative: heat-shock visible proxy fires at the first post-baseline sample.

bounded_bio_metrics.baseline_stable: Observed baseline recoverability must be high.
bounded_bio_metrics.early_detection: Observed k_star index must precede visible-failure proxy index for pass runs.
bounded_bio_metrics.control_contrast: Deterministic negative controls must not reproduce observed early detection.
bounded_bio_metrics.honest_negative: A primary dataset may be retained as a negative if the declared failure mode is reproduced.
bounded_bio_metrics.gene_set_comparator: When a curated gene set is supplied, HAOS-weighted ranking must beat simple fold-change by the declared margin.
